title: Cross-OS unattended sealed vault, OS keystore unlock, KeePassXC bridge, and cloud env protection
goal: Replace plaintext cloud.env/cloud-credentials reliance and Windows-DPAPI-only assumptions with an AEAD-sealed vault (ChaCha20-Poly1305) unsealed unattended via host OS keystores (systemd-creds/Freedesktop/keyfile on Linux, DPAPI on Windows, SUSI_VAULT_KEY/CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY in cloud), cross-OS KeePassXC + Google Drive sync bridge, and susi keys vault CLI.

reuse.searched: Checked susi-config::{secret_ref,credential,key_scope,cloud_env,cluster_key}, susi-vendor-chacha20poly1305, susi-vendor-sha2, susi-vendor-getrandom, susi-gemi-models::{cloud,cloud_credentials}, and host OS tools (keepassxc-cli, systemd-creds, secret-tool, Windows DPAPI ProtectedData, rclone).
reuse.reason: Reuses existing ChaCha20-Poly1305/SHA-256 primitives, SecretVault/KeyScope types, and OS tools; adds only the missing encrypted on-disk SealedVault store, unattended host unseal adapters, non-interactive KeePassXC/Google Drive bridge, and CLI/cloud wiring without new crates.
